I sort of fell in the middle, alternating between the reduced/free meal program and getting five bucks every so often, but mostly just brought my lunch. Boring, standard-issue mom stuff — PB&J, apple slices, maybe a juice pouch, raisins, whatever. Of course, like many other middle school yard sessions, trading lunch items was a big thing. Which brings me to Sam. Unlike kids with Lunchables or other “cool” items in their lunches, Sam was always willing to trade.
